qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant Swedish digital savings and pension platform with insurmountable scale economies shared (operating costs ~10 bps of customer capital vs 40+ bps for traditional Nordic banks). Erosion threats include Nordnet competition and potential regulatory changes to fund distribution kickbacks.
